model: snRNA-VEP v2-nested, label set v5c, frozen in ANALYSIS_PLAN.md

declared_evaluation_protocol.primary_metric: Spearman rho between score_dominant and the negated SGE function score, computed over all assayed SNVs with a structure node
declared_evaluation_protocol.success_criterion: score_dominant exceeds BOTH cadd_phred and phylop447, each with a position-block bootstrap 95% CI on the paired difference excluding zero
declared_evaluation_protocol.no_refitting: the model is not retrained, rescored or reselected after the screen is released; the scores in this file are final
declared_evaluation_protocol.reporting: the comparison is reported whatever its outcome, including failure

caveats: RNU2-2P and RNU5B-1 contributed to model training in the frozen v2-nested system; these are therefore NOT zero-shot predictions. A zero-shot variant of the comparison is also pre-declared below.
zero_shot_addendum: held-out scores for these genes, produced with the gene excluded from training, are in results/v2_heldout_predictions_labels_v5c.tsv.gz and should be used for the stricter test.
SGE measures a cell-fitness readout, not the clinical phenotype.
